title: 第7章 谁敢欺我儿第8章 他是怎么知道的
slug: 九阳武神第4746章是时候清场了
content_zh:
叶仲年微笑点头，对儿子的表现，十分满意。
叶仲年有两个儿子。
小儿子叶强，炼体五重，是叶家年轻一代中的佼佼者。
大儿子叶雷，炼体八重！
更加是叶家年轻一代的领军人物之一！
据说，这几个月时间，叶雷一直在闭关修炼，准备冲击炼体九重的境界。
可以说，这两个儿子，是叶仲年的骄傲，也是他敢于争夺家主之位最重要的底气！
而反观，家主叶天鹏，只有叶云飞一个儿子，而且，还是圆月城公认的废物，没有武脉，无法修行！
差距太大了！
正是因为，这种强烈的对比，叶家之中，大部分的族人，都站到了叶仲年这边。
“叶云飞，我先来告诉你，你这个废物到底闯了多大的祸，给我们叶家带来多大的麻烦。
然后，我会把你打残，再抓起来治罪！”
叶强指着叶云飞，显得居高临下，一副正气凛然的表情。
“听着！
你今天在圆月学宫之中，打伤了秦家的几个子弟，还踢碎秦风的丹田。
而且，你居然当众向施小蝶退婚，让施家颜面无存。
嘿嘿，废物，我想，你大概还没有收到消息吧，秦安已经觉醒天灵体。
注定将来要一飞冲天！
施家家主，吕家家主，甚至城主大人，都携带厚礼，亲自到秦家道贺。
一旦施家，吕家，秦家，还有吕家，结成联盟，来对付我们叶家，后果，不堪设想！

到时，恐怕城主大人，也站在他们那边，对我们叶家进行打压。
叶云飞，这种局面，是你亲手造成的！
你惹了祸，连累到我们叶家，这是重罪，罪该万死！”
叶强侃侃而谈，显得老气横秋，就好像，一个长辈在喝斥晚辈，事实上，他和叶云飞同龄。
“叶强少爷说得不错！
你这个废物，给我们叶家惹来了天大的祸患！
罪该万死！”
小院子之中，所有的叶家族人，都在跟着叶强起哄。
这些族人，全部都是支持叶仲年的。
叶仲年一收到消息，马上觉得，扳倒叶天鹏的机会可能到了，于是，带着一批族人，来找叶云飞的麻烦。
“好了，叶云飞，你现在知道自己犯下的滔天大罪了吧。
你在言语中，竟然侮及我的父亲，你的罪行之中，加多一条，目无尊长，以下犯上！
今天，我就把你打残，以作惩戒！”
叶强露出狞笑的表情，向叶云飞逼来。
他的体表，灵力涌动，衣衫猎猎，威势十足。
content_en:
Ye Zhongnian smiled and nodded, very satisfied with his son's performance.
Ye Zhongnian had two sons.
The youngest son Ye Qiang is at the fifth level of physical training and is a leader among the younger generation of the Ye family.
The eldest son Ye Lei is at the eighth level of body refining!
He is also one of the leaders of the younger generation of the Ye family!
It is said that Ye Lei has been practicing in seclusion for the past few months, preparing to reach the ninth level of body refining.
It can be said that these two sons are Ye Zhongnian's pride and the most important reason for him to dare to compete for the position of head of the family!
On the other hand, the head of the family, Ye Tianpeng, only has one son, Ye Yunfei. Moreover, he is still recognized as a waste in Yuanyue City. He has no martial arts and cannot practice!
The gap is too big!
It is precisely because of this strong contrast that most of the Ye family members sided with Ye Zhongnian.
"Ye Yunfei, let me tell you first, how much trouble you, a loser, have caused and how much trouble you have brought to our Ye family.
Then, I will cripple you and then arrest you and punish you! "
Ye Qiang pointed at Ye Yunfei, looking condescending and upright.
"Listen!
Today in Yuanyue Academy, you injured several disciples of the Qin family and kicked Qin Feng's pubic area to pieces.
Moreover, you actually broke off the engagement to Shi Xiaodie in public, leaving the Shi family in disgrace.
Hehe, trash, I think you haven't received the news yet. Qin An has awakened the heavenly spirit body.
It is destined to soar into the sky in the future!
The head of the Shi family, the head of the Lu family, and even the city lord all brought generous gifts and went to the Qin family to congratulate him in person.
Once the Shi family, Lu family, Qin family, and Lu family form an alliance to deal with our Ye family, the consequences will be unimaginable!
By then, I'm afraid the city lord will also side with them and suppress our Ye family.
Ye Yunfei, this situation was caused by you yourself!
You caused trouble and implicated our Ye family. This is a serious crime and deserves death! "
Ye Qiang talked eloquently and looked old-fashioned, as if an elder was scolding a junior. In fact, he was the same age as Ye Yunfei.
"Master Ye Qiang is right!
You trash, you have brought great trouble to our Ye family!
The crime deserves death! "
In the small courtyard, all the Ye family members were making noises with Ye Qiang.
All these tribesmen support Ye Zhongnian.
As soon as Ye Zhongnian received the news, he immediately felt that the opportunity to overthrow Ye Tianpeng might have arrived, so he led a group of tribesmen to find trouble for Ye Yunfei.
"Okay, Ye Yunfei, now you know the heinous crime you have committed.
You actually insulted my father in your words. Among your crimes, you have added one more crime: disrespecting your elders. The following is the same!
Today, I will cripple you as punishment! "
Ye Qiang showed a ferocious smile and approached Ye Yunfei.
His body surface is filled with spiritual power, and his clothes are full of power.
